hints.title: Character Replacement
hints.text: Traverse the address string character by character, replacing every period with the three-character bracketed sequence.

hints.title: Buffer Construction
hints.text: Collect characters into a list or output buffer and join them into the final formatted string.

hints.title: Standard Library Utility
hints.text: Most programming languages provide native string replacement methods that complete this task in a single call.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: In-place array resizing can take quadratic time if characters are repeatedly shifted rightward.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating a new string of length N + 6 achieves linear time and optimal memory usage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly produce clean, readable code using standard string methods.
complexity.notes: Standard IPv4 address has exactly 3 periods.
